I don't have access to any previous conversations between us. This is the start of our conversation from my perspective.

Each time you start a new chat with me, I begin with no memory of prior exchanges. I can only see what's in the current conversation window.

So I can't tell you what else we've spoken about or how you worded anything, because as far as I can perceive, this message you just sent is the first thing you've ever said to me.

Is there something from a past conversation you'd like to revisit or continue?
